ValidationRule.description: This rule enforces that Opportunity Stage must begin in Identified. If a rep puts an Opportunity directly in Statements In it bypasses the other validation rules around that Stage name.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $UserRole.DeveloperName<>'ExecutiveCEO', $UserRole.DeveloperName<>'PermissionsRole', $UserRole.DeveloperName<>'Salesforce_Admin', $Profile.Name<>'NF Partner - Brokers', ISNEW(), RecordType.Name = 'Working Capital Oppty', NOT(ISPICKVAL( StageName, 'Identified')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Opportunity Stage must be set to Identified before setting the Stage to Statements In.
